description.zh: 组ID列表，单次操作最多支持100个组ID。
description.en: The list of group IDs. You can specify up to 100 group IDs in a single request.

title.zh: 取消多个EIAM组访问一个应用的权限
title.en: Revoke the permissions of multiple EIAM groups to access an application

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eiam revoke-application-from-groups --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --application-id app_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx --group-ids group_miu8e4t4d7i4u7uwezgr54xxxx --application-role-id app_role_mkv7rgt4ds8d8v0qtzev2mxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eiam RevokeApplicationFromGroups --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --GroupIds.1 group_miu8e4t4d7i4u7uwezgr54xxxx --ApplicationId app_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx --ApplicationRoleId app_role_mkv7rgt4ds8d8v0qtzev2mxxxx --method POST --force
